description: Election Commission - M. T. R. Fernando of the Kesbewa Urban Council has Vacated his Office of member of the U.N.P. - D. M. D. S. Prasanna of the Kesbewa Urban Council has Vacated his Office of the member of the U. N. P.
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that a member of the Kesbewa Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and electoral commission decisions.
